method: Paired whole-family percentile bootstrap, identical draw for both frozen models; AP and AUROC recomputed with tie groups and family multiplicities; Brier added minus control, negative favours added; no selection uncertainty; two-sided 95% pointwise intervals; empty/single-label draws excluded for a common metric set. Weighted calculations validated against sklearn and literal duplicated rows.
scope: Original and structural analyses reuse consumed outcomes; fresh predictors predate fresh evaluation outcomes; intervals added retrospectively without refitting.
